result:
The only consumers of `useAbortController` in the patient chart are the two exported workspace forms, one for lab results and one for vitals. Both pass the controller's signal into request functions, so a change to the hook's abort or reuse semantics would reach those requests.

**Patient chart consumers (best first)**

1. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-orders-app/src/lab-results/exported-lab-results-form.workspace.tsx` (`ExportedLabResultsForm`, hook call at line 70). The controller is passed to `fetchSavedLabResults` (line 254), and to the save and completion paths (lines 304 and 338).
2. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/vitals-biometrics-form/exported-vitals-biometrics-form.workspace.tsx` (`ExportedVitalsAndBiometricsForm`, hook call at line 87). The controller is passed to `createOrUpdateVitalsAndBiometrics` (line 231) and listed as a save-callback dependency (line 267).
3. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-orders-app/src/lab-results/lab-results.resource.ts`, `completeOrderWithSavedResults` (lines 302–325). It forwards the signal to `openmrsFetch` calls and to `updateOrderFulfillerDetails`.
4. Same file, `updateOrderResult` (lines 278–296). It forwards the signal to `openmrsFetch`.
5. Same file, `fetchSavedLabResults` (lines 265–272). It forwards the signal to `openmrsFetch`.
6. Same file, `updateOrderFulfillerDetails` (lines 327–336). It is a private helper that forwards the signal to `openmrsFetch`.
7. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/common/data.resource.ts`, `createOrUpdateVitalsAndBiometrics` (declared at line 527). It receives the controller from the vitals form. I did not read its body, so I have not confirmed how it uses the signal.

**Framework declarations (the code that would change)**

8. `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-react-utils/src/useAbortController.ts` (lines 25–38). This is the hook itself. It reuses the same controller until the controller is aborted or the component unmounts, and then aborts it on unmount.
9. `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-react-utils/mock.tsx` (line 108). This is the Vitest mock. Tests in the chart that mock the hook would not reflect a behaviour change.
10. `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-react-utils/mock-jest.tsx` (line 103). This is the Jest mock, with the same caveat.
11. `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-framework/docs/functions/useAbortController.md` (line 3). This is the generated API doc.

I found no other `useAbortController` references in the patient chart. Falkon's grep and symbol lookup both returned only these two files.
